artworks.title: Marchioness of Baden
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman showing her from the waist upwards. She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. Her facial features include a slightly rounded face, prominent eyes, a small mouth, and an elegantly styled high forehead. Her hair is swept back and styled in an intricate, up-do fashion surrounded by an embellished headpiece. She is wearing a richly ornated gown with an elaborate lace collar that fans out dramatically around her neck. A visible adornment of pearls decorates her bodice, and she is wearing pearl earrings. The background consists of a circular border with Latin inscriptions surrounding the portrait and a patterned texture filling the area around her head. The section below the border contains a block of text.

artworks.title: Elizabeth van Pallandt, Countess of Culemborg, Wife of Jacob, Margrave of Baden
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body. She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. Her facial features are delicately rendered with high cheekbones and a smooth complexion. She has an elaborate hairstyle with her hair pulled back in a high bun adorned with ribbons. The woman is wearing an ornate garment with a large ruffled collar. The attire includes a richly textured dress, possibly with embroidery or patterning. The background is solid with a circular border enclosing the portrait, featuring an inscription around it. Beneath the image, there is additional text.

artworks.title: David Baker
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the side. The man has a prominent forehead, deeply set eyes, and a beard and mustache covering his chin and lip area. His hair is sparse and receding. He is wearing a dark, hooded garment typical of a monastic robe. The background is a textured surface with drapery effects.

artworks.title: Walter Baker, Inventor of a Medicine
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in 18th-century attire seated in a chair. He is facing slightly to the left, looking at the viewer. The man has a detailed face with visible eyes, nose, and lips. He has a wig styled in soft curls. The man's clothing includes a dark coat with buttons and a decorative collar. His left arm rests on a surface, possibly holding a pen, directed towards an open book on a table in front of him. The chair has carved details on the left side. The background is heavily shaded, focusing on the man's head and upper body, with the rest of the image plain.

artworks.title: John Bale, Bishop of Ossory
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This portrait depicts a man from the waist up, positioned slightly turned to the left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a long, full beard and mustache, and his hair is mostly covered by a cap. The man is wearing a dark garment with a visible collar. He holds a closed book in the crook of his left arm. The background consists of a simple cross-hatched pattern, with textured shading around the figure highlighting his features.

artworks.title: John Bale, Bishop of Ossory
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's portrait showing the upper half of his body. He is posed in a slightly turned stance, looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a well-defined mustache and short, wavy hair framing his face. He is wearing a detailed, patterned gown with a collar and draped with a sash over his left shoulder. In his left hand, he holds a pair of dividers, pointing them at a globe. The background consists of an intricately hatched oval frame with text surrounding it, and additional writing below the oval.

artworks.title: John Bale, Bishop of Ossory
artworks.description: The image shows a man's head and shoulders, facing slightly to the right with a stern expression. He has a high forehead, a long beard and mustache, and wears a fabric cap. The man is dressed in historical clothing, likely a robe or cloak. The background features an oval frame, typical of an engraving, with text surrounding the man's portrait and additional text below the oval.

artworks.title: William Knollys, Earl of Banbury, When Viscount Wallingford
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man from the torso up. The man is seated and turned slightly to his left. He has a furrowed brow, a beard, and a mustache. He wears a tall, flat-brimmed hat, and his hair is short and curls slightly from underneath his hat. His clothing is detailed, featuring a coat with puffed sleeves, ornate buttons, and embroidery. He wears a large, ruffled collar around his neck. In one hand, he holds a small book or document. The background shows a frame with ribbons and banners containing Latin text, along with a coat of arms at the top of the frame.

artworks.title: Richard Bancroft, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man seated and facing slightly towards the viewer. The man has a calm expression, a full beard and mustache, and is dressed in a clerical outfit with a white ruffled collar, dark robes, and a flat cap. The portrait is encased in an ornate oval frame with decorative elements. Below the portrait is a plaque inscribed in Latin identifying the man as Richardus Bancroft, Archbishop, with a shield and religious symbols. The background has floral patterns in the corners.

artworks.title: John Barclay
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up. He is gazing directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The man has a high forehead, prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, neatly styled wavy hair, a short beard, and mustache. He is wearing a garment with ornate patterns and a high, wide collar with intricate detailing. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background features horizontal lines. The portrait is framed with inscriptions above and below.

artworks.title: John Barclay
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the waist up. He has distinct facial features and is wearing an elaborate robe with an ornate lace collar. He has short, curly hair and a small goatee. The background features a draped fabric, adding texture to the setting. The portrait is monochrome and detailed, resembling an engraving style.

artworks.title: John Barclay
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man facing the viewer. He has distinct features including defined eyebrows, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, a pointed nose, and a mustache with a short-pointed beard. His hair is styled in curls framing his face. He is wearing a detailed garment with an elaborate ruffled collar. The background consists of horizontal lines, with accompanying text above and below the image.

artworks.title: John Barclay
artworks.artist: Jacob van der Heyden after Jan van der Heyden
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a man's head and upper torso. He is turned slightly to his left, with his body facing forward. He has facial hair, including a mustache and a pointed beard. His full hair is styled back from his forehead. The man is wearing a high-collared garment with ornate patterns, including lines and dots. The garment has an elaborate, pointed collar. The background of the engraving consists of fine horizontal lines. There is text at the top of the image stating "Jo. Barclaius" and his birth and death dates. The lower part of the image contains a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: John Barclay
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the bust upwards, slightly turned to the right with his head facing forward. He has distinctive facial features, including a high forehead, large, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a pointed chin framed by a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. His hair is dark, curly, and voluminous, extending at the sides and back of his head. He is dressed in a richly decorated jacket, featuring an intricate design of interwoven lines and circles. The jacket includes a high, wide collar that appears elaborately stitched. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background is a simple oval frame with closely drawn parallel lines filling the space.

artworks.title: John Barclay
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the subject from the chest up. The person is facing slightly to the viewer's left with a direct gaze. The person has a styled mustache and a small pointed beard, with wavy hair combed away from the face. They are wearing a richly decorated garment with intricate patterns and a high, ruffled collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame that is part of the illustration, with crosshatching shading in the background. The name "IOANNES BARCLAIVS" is inscribed at the bottom of the image on a labeled border.

artworks.title: John Barclay
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man, captured from the chest upward. The man is positioned slightly turned to his right, with his head slightly tilted back and eyes looking forward. He has a short, pointed beard and a mustache, with neatly styled back and slightly wavy hair. He wears an ornate garment with a high, wide collar and intricate patterns or embroidery. The portrait is in an oval frame with a detailed, lined background, and the name "IOANNES BARCLAIVS" is inscribed below. The surrounding area includes a decorative border, and the portrait is placed on a textured, aged-looking page with visible edge wear and faint text.

artworks.title: William Barclay
artworks.description: The image features a detailed black and white etching of a bust portrait of a man. The man's upper body is shown facing forward and slightly turned to his right. He has a high forehead with receding hairline, prominent eyebrows, sharp eyes, a long pointed mustache with a small goatee, and drawn back hair. He is dressed in formal attire, likely historical or scholarly. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The portrait is encased in an ornate oval frame with heraldic symbols on both sides and Latin text above and below. The background has an intricately designed border with coats of arms and patterns, emphasizing a sense of prestige and nobility.

artworks.title: William Barclay
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man in an ornate oval frame. The man is depicted facing forward with his body slightly turned to the left. He has a mustache, a small beard, and neatly groomed hair. He wears a high-collared shirt, a vest, and a coat. The background consists of coat of arms and inscriptions. There is a Latin inscription above the portrait and additional text below the frame. The design includes heraldic symbols.

artworks.title: Gulielmus Baudartius, Theologian and Historian
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man with a full, long beard and intense gaze. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has receding hair and wears a high-collared garment with fur trim. The background features an ornate frame with scrolls, fruit, and decorative elements. The frame includes elaborate text in Latin. Below the portrait is a section with more text set on a stone plaque, flanked by decorative sculptures.

artworks.title: Jean de Beaugrand
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after Pierre Dumonstier I
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body depiction of a man seated at a desk. He is positioned facing slightly to the left with his arm resting on the desk as he writes with a quill pen. His facial features include a well-groomed mustache and a small pointed beard on his chin. His hair is combed back from his forehead. He is wearing a high-collared shirt with a large, elaborate ruffle known as a ruff, which is buttoned up along the front. The man's coat appears to be fitted and stylishly tailored. In the background, the surface has a crosshatch pattern, adding texture and depth, while above the image is a decorative band with ornamental writing.

artworks.title: Thomas Becon, Protestant Divine
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is in a sideways position, facing right. The man has a long, pointed beard and a mustache. He has wavy hair partially covered by a cap. He is wearing a heavy fur-collared garment. The man is holding a book. The background features a pattern of small dots. Under the portrait, there is text reading "THOMAS BECONS" along with a short Latin phrase.

artworks.title: Thomas Becon, D.D.
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut of a man facing right. The man appears to be holding a book at chest level. He has distinct facial features, a beard, a mustache, flat cap, and a garment with a fur collar. In the background, there is a shelf with books. The paper has text around the image, indicating details about the subject and the date, reading "ATATIS SUA 41 AN D 1553" and identifying him as a theology professor.

artworks.title: Abel Bede, Minister
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up, in a seated position facing slightly to the left. He is holding a small closed book in his left hand. The man has a stern expression with deep-set eyes, a straight nose, a pointed mustache, and a slightly receding hairline with short cropped hair. He is wearing a dark garment with an intricate ruff around his neck. The background features a patterned, textured area and an emblem or seal at the top. There is text on the portrait indicating the person's name and title beneath the image, with ornate calligraphy.

artworks.title: Robert Bellarmin, Cardinal
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is positioned facing forward, with his body slightly turned to the side, holding a book in his left hand with his right hand resting on it. The man has distinct facial features with a broad forehead, pointed nose, slightly downturned eyes, and a firm mouth. His hair is closely cropped, and he wears a clerical cap. He is wearing an elaborate robe typical of high-ranking clergy members, with a thick collar around his neck. The image is framed by an oval design with scrollwork, and a small open book is seen resting on a shelf near him. The background has a patterned texture. Above him, there are several books aligned on a shelf. The engraving includes text identifying the subject as Robert Bellarmin, a Cardinal of the Church of Rome.
